basics.name: Hicham Benoukaiss
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.bio: Junior Software Developer with experience building production mobile and full-stack applications using React Native, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot. Strong foundation in algorithms, system design, and backend development through the 1337 Coding School curriculum.
basics.status: I'm currently looking for an internship opportunity. Whether you have a question or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out!

experience.description: Developed and shipped production mobile features and backend services in a collaborative engineering team.
highlights: Developed and shipped production mobile features using React Native by building reusable, maintainable components that improved development efficiency and user experience.
Designed and implemented RESTful backend APIs with Spring Boot to support core application functionality.
Integrated AI-powered backend functionality by connecting inference services with existing APIs and business logic.
Reduced unnecessary API requests and improved application responsiveness through client-side caching strategies.
Collaborated with DevOps, Data Engineering, and AI teams to integrate deployment workflows, backend services, and data pipelines.
Improved application reliability by debugging production issues, optimizing performance, and implementing new features.

education.description: Intensive, project-based curriculum in software development, algorithms, and system design.

education.degree: Bachelor's Degree in Fundamental Sciences (Mathematics and Computer Science)
education.description: Specialized in applied mathematics, data structures, and software engineering principles.

projects.title: Ping Pong Platform
projects.description: Built a full-stack real-time multiplayer platform featuring authentication, matchmaking, friend management, and integrated chat using TypeScript, React, and Fastify. Implemented OAuth 2.0 with JWT and PostgreSQL for persistent data storage.

projects.title: HTTP Web Server
projects.description: Built an HTTP/1.1 web server from scratch in C++. Implemented non-blocking I/O using epoll (Linux) and kqueue (macOS) to support concurrent client connections, request routing, static file serving, and CGI execution.

projects.title: Inception – Dockerized WordPress Infrastructure
projects.description: Designed and deployed a production-like multi-container infrastructure using Docker Compose. Configured NGINX, WordPress, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, and Redis with isolated networking, TLS 1.3, and containerization best practices.

projects.title: Password Manager
projects.description: Developed a secure password storage application with React, Tailwind CSS, and Spring Boot. Used Spring Security and PostgreSQL for encrypted storage and authentication.
